_classes.name: passive-subject or descriptive actor_raw (queued for re-ask; recurs)
actor_raw with a parenthetical (fixed class, recurs)
sunset-extension applicability clause dropped by exemption_or_applicability gate (real extends_existing power lost; mirror clause in same law kept)
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='exemption_or_applicability' and re.search(r'shall (not )?(only )?(be applicable|apply)',quote) and re.search(r'period from|commenced|until|on and after',quote)

_classes.name: State Liquor Authority (named board) stored as agency ABC with agency_unit null
_classes.rule: agency=='ABC' and not agency_unit and 'liquor authority' in (actor_resolved_model+' '+actor_raw).lower()

_classes.name: 'notwithstanding' place/class exception that widens an existing power stored extends_existing false
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and re.match(r'\s*notwithstanding the provisions of (paragraph|subdivision|section)',quote,re.I) and extends_existing is False

_classes.name: sunset extension of a prior chapter with no actor named in the act text produces no record
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: laws whose only section amends another chapter's expiry and names no actor
